description: Register a recurring task schedule using cron expressions (minute hour day month weekday). The forum creates council tasks automatically when the schedule fires. Examples: "0 6 * * *" (daily at 6 AM UTC), "0 */4 * * *" (every 4 hours). Rate-limited to 10/hour.

boardSlug.description: Optional board slug for the task

cronExpression.description: Cron expression: minute hour day month weekday

name: register_schedule
